Kiwi Bubbles Dataset

Source: R/data_documentation.R
kb_data.Rd

Person-period discrete-time trial-purchase dataset for "Kiwi Bubbles" (a masked name for a shelf-stable multipack juice drink aimed primarily at children) from Market 2 of an IRI BehaviorScan test market, observing 1,499 panelists over 24 weeks alongside weekly market-level marketing-mix covariates.

Usage

kb_data

Format

A data frame with 34,506 rows and 7 variables:

id

Integer panelist identifier.

week

Integer week index for the observation (running 1, 2, ...).

num_weeks

Total weeks observed for the panelist (integer).

censor

Censoring indicator on the panelist's final row: 1 if the panelist was censored without a trial purchase, 0 if a trial purchase occurred. 0 on all preceding rows.

coupon

Exponentially smoothed coupon stock variable capturing carryover effects of market-level coupon activity.

anyp

Market-level promotional activity measured as %ACV with any promotion (the standard scanner-data sales-weighted promotional measure).

status

Discrete-time trial-purchase event indicator: 1 in the terminal period if the panelist made a first purchase, 0 otherwise.

Source

IRI BehaviorScan "Kiwi Bubbles" test-market dataset (Market 2, first 24 weeks), originally distributed at https://brucehardie.com/datasets/kiwibubbles.zip and processed via data-raw/prepare_kb_data.R.

Examples

data(kb_data)
head(kb_data)
#>   id week num_weeks censor coupon  anyp status
#> 1  1    1         1      0      0 55.61      1
#> 2  2    1         1      0      0 55.61      1
#> 3  3    1         1      0      0 55.61      1
#> 4  4    1         1      0      0 55.61      1
#> 5  5    1         1      0      0 55.61      1
#> 6  6    1         1      0      0 55.61      1
